## 2. Custom Control Panels (Manufacturing & Standards)
All control panels designed and built by Nascon Technologies comply with the international standard IEC 61439-1/2 (Low-voltage switchgear and controlgear assemblies) and Indian Standard IS 8623.

### Types of Panels Manufactured:
1. **PLC Automation Control Panels**:
   - Fabricated in CRCA sheet steel (1.6mm / 2.0mm) or Stainless Steel (SS304/SS316) for pharmaceutical/corrosive plants.
   - Protection Rating: IP54 / IP55 / IP65.
   - Integrates controllers from Siemens (S7-1200, S7-1500), Schneider Electric (Modicon M221, M241, M251), or Phoenix Contact (PLCnext).
   - Segregated low-voltage 24VDC control wiring and 415VAC power wiring with colour-coded ferruling.
   - Built-in redundant power supply, surge protection (SPD), and Ethernet managed switches.

2. **VFD & Variable Speed Drive Panels**:
   - Tailored for variable torque (pumps, fans) and constant torque (conveyors, extruders, cranes, mixers).
   - Incorporates Schneider Altivar (ATV630, ATV930, ATV320) or Siemens SINAMICS (G120, V20) drives.
   - Thermostatically controlled forced-air cooling fans, line reactors (chokes), and du/dt filters.
   - Integrated manual bypass switchgear to ensure zero downtime.

3. **Motor Control Centers (MCC & iMCC)**:
   - Fixed and fully draw-out compartment designs.
   - Intelligent MCC features RS-485 Modbus or PROFINET networked electronic motor protection relays, energy meters, and remote diagnostics.

4. **Power Control Centers (PCC)**:
   - High-fault current withstand rating (up to 50kA / 65kA for 1 sec).
   - Air Circuit Breakers (ACB) and Moulded Case Circuit Breakers (MCCB) up to 4000A.

5. **APFC & iPFC Panels (Automatic Power Factor Correction)**:
   - Microprocessor-based multi-stage power factor controllers.
   - Heavy-duty detuned harmonic filter reactors (7% / 14%) and MPP capacitor banks to maintain power factor above 0.99 lag.

6. **RTU & Remote Telemetry Panels**:
   - Outdoor solar-powered or mains-powered telemetry enclosures for water networks, tubewells, pipelines, and remote substations with 4G/5G/LoRa industrial modems.

1. **Phoenix Contact**:
   - Push-in terminal blocks (PT series), screw terminals (UK series), QUINT/TRIO power supplies, RIFLINE interface relays, M12 industrial Ethernet connectors, surge arresters, and PLCnext controllers.
   - URL: https://nascontechnologies.com/partners/phoenix
2. **Multispan**:
   - Microcontroller-based PID temperature controllers, digital multi-channel scanners, timers, sequential timers, digital ammeters/voltmeters, and power transducers.
   - URL: https://nascontechnologies.com/partners/multispan
3. **Schneider Electric**:
   - TeSys D and TeSys F contactors, LRD thermal overload relays, Acti9 MCBs/RCCBs, EasyPact and Compact NSX MCCBs, MasterPact ACBs, Modicon PLCs, Magelis/Harmony HMIs.
   - URL: https://nascontechnologies.com/partners/schneider
4. **Siemens**:
   - SIMATIC S7-1200 / S7-1500 PLCs, SIMATIC KTP and Comfort touchscreen panels, SINAMICS V20 / G120 VFDs, SIRIUS 3RT contactors and 3RU overload relays.
   - URL: https://nascontechnologies.com/partners/siemens
5. **Selec**:
   - Multifunction energy meters (MFM383A, MFM384), digital panel meters, multi-range analogue and digital timers, voltage/current protection relays, and programmable logic controllers.
   - URL: https://nascontechnologies.com/partners/selec
6. **Finolex Cables**:
   - Flexible copper panel wires, multi-core shielded control cables, PVC/XLPE insulated industrial power cables with high electrical conductivity and flame-retardant jacket.
   - URL: https://nascontechnologies.com/partners/finolex
7. **Gloster Cables**:
   - Heavy-duty HT (up to 33kV) and LT armoured aluminium/copper cables, specialized instrumentation cables (pair/triad with overall aluminum foil screen), and fire-survival cables.
   - URL: https://nascontechnologies.com/partners/gloster

## 4. Testing, Quality Assurance & FAT Procedures
Every panel produced at the Pithampur facility undergoes a 7-point factory acceptance testing (FAT) protocol before release:
1. Physical enclosure, gasket sealing, paint coating DFT (microns), and mechanical fitment inspection.
2. Complete point-to-point wiring continuity verification matching engineering schematics.
3. High Voltage (HV) flash test (up to 2.5kV) and Insulation Resistance (megger test > 100 Megaohms).
4. Earthing continuity test on all structural members, doors, and mounting plates.
5. Control circuit logic simulation under full power with actual PLC and HMI programming loaded.
6. Temperature rise and thermal validation under simulated load conditions.
7. Comprehensive dispatch documentation pack: GA drawings, SLD, terminal wiring diagrams, Bill of Materials (BOM), and certified FAT test reports.
